description_en: Queries the details of a specified rule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定规则的详细信息
name: GetRule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule to query. You can view the rule ID on the **Message Forwarding** > **Data Forwarding** page of the corresponding instance in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html to obtain the rule ID from the response
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的规则ID。可在物联网平台控制台对应实例下，**消息转发**>**云产品流转**页查看规则ID，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html从返回结果中查看
parameters.name: rule_id
